name: Rotsworn Carrier

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The carrier makes two Bite attacks.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature and doesn't already have a wasting wound, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 14. *Failure:* The target receives a wasting wound. While wounded, the target loses 7 (2d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, succeeding on a DC 14 Wisdom (Medicine) check.
Actions.clause: a plague-bearer whose bite spreads a wasting sickness

Traits.name: Rotsworn Aura
Traits.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 14, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the carrier. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the carrier's next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.

lore: Once a living body, it was bloated and re-woven by a nameless rot that only wants to be carried from host to host, and it wears the sickness on its hide and in its jaws as both weapon and offspring.
